verbatim_statement: 那时间就是十一点十五分，这是我完成全部L1,2,3代码以及运行图片的时间，在十一点十五分到十二点十分是我进行盲测的时间
interpretation: I recorded when the regular code and figures were ready and when I worked on the blind analysis. The archived blind hash identifies the version recorded at submission. The Git object for that hash is unavailable.
relationship_to_QMplus_receipt: I used Singapore time (UTC+8) for my work and UK local time for the QMplus display. On the associated date, 24 September 2026, 10:42 BST corresponds to 17:42 in Singapore. I recorded 12:10 Singapore time as the end of the blind analysis. QMplus shows 17:42 Singapore time as the last-modified time.
verbatim_timezone_clarification: 截图时间为UK时间，真实时间你可以认为是新加坡（UTC+8）时间
event_date_basis: I used the date in the QMplus screenshot and the original run log for the conversion. My later clarification specified the time zones.
